params.name: participants
params.description: Comma-separated list of participant codes to filter on (e.g. `ABCDEF,DEMO01`).

params.name: account_type
params.description: Filter for a specific account_type

params.name: account_status
params.description: Filter for a specific account_status

params.name: page
params.description: Filter for a specific page (pagination)

params.name: size
params.description: Filter for the amount of external account objects returned

items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of external accounts linked to the calling platform, optionally filtered by participants, account type, or account status.
Links an external fiat or crypto account to a participant. Fiat accounts are linked via a Plaid processor token. Crypto account support requires the feature to be enabled on the calling platform.

params.name: external_account_id
params.description: Identifier of the external account to close.

items.docs: Closes an external account previously linked to a participant. After closure the account can no longer be used for new payments.

params.name: participant_code
params.description: Filter for participant code

params.name: page
params.description: Filter for a specific page (pagination)

params.name: size
params.description: Filter for the amount of payments returned

params.name: start_date
params.description: Unix timestamp in seconds. Returns payments created on or after this date.

params.name: end_date
params.description: Unix timestamp in seconds. Returns payments created on or before this date.

items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of payouts for the platform, optionally filtered by `participant_code` and a `start_date` / `end_date` window.
Creates a fiat pre-fund/settlement or a crypto payout. The request body must match one of the four documented shapes; submitting both `total` and `quantity` on a payout is rejected.

params.name: payment_id
params.description: Identifier of the payout to fetch.

items.docs: Fetches a single payout by its identifier, returning the current lifecycle status and on-chain details.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Inclusive start of the query window as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Defaults to 2 days ago.

params.name: end_date
params.description: Inclusive end of the query window as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Defaults to now.

params.name: platform_code
params.description: Platform code to fetch pending settlements for.

params.name: page
params.description: Filter for a specific page (pagination)

params.name: size
params.description: Filter for the amount of pending ACH transaction objects returned

items.docs: Retrieves pending ACH settlements for a specific platform. Used by the platform to reconcile the daily ACH settlement window.

params.name: transaction_id
params.description: Identifier of the fiat transaction to retry.

items.docs: Retries a failed, cancelled, or returned fiat transaction whose linked trade has already terminated.

params.name: participant
params.description: Filter to a single participant code.

params.name: transaction_ids
params.description: Optional list of transaction identifiers to fetch. Repeat the query parameter for multiple ids (e.g. `?transaction_ids=id1&transaction_ids=id2`).

params.name: transfer_type
params.description: Filter for the given `transfer_type`

params.name: page
params.description: Filter for a specific page (pagination)

params.name: size
params.description: Filter for the amount of transaction objects will be returned per request

items.docs: Retrieves the historical fiat transactions (ACH / same-day ACH / wire / RTP) for the calling platform, with optional filters by participant, transfer type, or a set of transaction identifiers.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Inclusive start of the query window as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

params.name: end_date
params.description: Inclusive end of the query window as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

params.name: participant
params.description: Filter for the given `participant` code

params.name: transaction_id
params.description: Filter for the given `transaction_id`

params.name: trade_id
params.description: Filter for the given `trade_id`

params.name: status
params.description: Filter for the given `status` of the transaction

params.name: page
params.description: Filter for a specific page (pagination)

params.name: size
params.description: Filter for the amount of transaction status objects returned

items.docs: Retrieves fiat transaction status objects for the calling platform. Defaults: when `start_date`/`end_date` are omitted, the last day of transactions is returned; when `page`/`size` are omitted, the first 200 transactions are returned; omitting `participant` or `status` removes the respective filter.
Retrieves a quote for a payout. Exactly one of `quantity` or `total` must be supplied. The returned `quote_id` can be passed to `POST /payments/execute` before `expire_ts`.
Executes the quote identified by `quote_id` and creates the underlying fiat transaction. The quote must not have expired.
